summary:
Cloud Architect with 7+ years of experience in the Banking & Financial Services (BFSI) domain, including extensive involvement in the Syntax Banking Transformation Project. Specialized in AWS cloud architecture, banking modernization, DevOps automation, hybrid integrations, and regulatory-compliant secure infrastructure design.
Cloud Architecture & Design
Designed secure, scalable, multi-region AWS architectures aligned with AWS Well-Architected Framework.
Created HLD/LLD and integration designs for Core Banking, Digital Banking, LOS, CCMS, and DCMS platforms.
Built hybrid architectures integrating AWS with legacy core banking systems.
Defined NFRs including security, performance, DR, and scalability for mission-critical banking applications.
Cloud Migration & Modernization
Led on-prem to AWS migrations using lift-and-shift, re-platforming, and re-architecture strategies.
Utilized AWS Migration Hub, DMS, MAP, and CloudEndure for seamless transitions.
Modernized monolithic applications to microservices using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/ECS).
Migrated IBM WebSphere Liberty workloads to AWS with Harness CI/CD.
Achieved ~30% cost optimization and improved system availability.
DevOps & Automation
Built CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Harness.
Reduced deployment time by 40% through automation.
Developed Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, and AWS CDK.
Automated provisioning and deployment processes to reduce manual errors.
Security & Compliance (BFSI)
Implemented IAM RBAC, MFA, KMS encryption, and Secrets Manager best practices.
Configured AWS Config, CloudTrail, Security Hub, WAF, and Shield.
Designed secure VPC, VPN, firewall, load balancer, and DMZ architectures for financial systems.
Ensured compliance with banking regulatory and audit standards.
Infrastructure, Performance & Leadership
Architected HA infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, and databases.
Implemented monitoring using CloudWatch, X-Ray, and ELK Stack.
Designed DR strategies ensuring business continuity.
Led cross-functional teams and acted as technical advisor to stakeholders.
Delivered projects using Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies.
